The date 2026-11-19 in metadata is the retrieval date, not the date of imagery acquisition or survey. Data is simplified/resampled for visualization. Interpretative architectural meshes, colours and vegetation are not survey measurements.

## Historic-center expansion

Elevation sampling uses the official Terrain-RGB service derived from **MDT05 (5 m source grid)**. Its 1,025 × 1,025 application grid is interpolated at approximately 2 m; this does not establish 2 m survey accuracy.

Building roof-height estimates are derived from the **IGN/CNIG MDSnE2.5 normalized building surface model, first PNOA-LiDAR coverage**. Retrieval date is not survey date. Fields retain source and sample statistics, and OSM height/levels are unchanged.

Product metadata: https://datos.gob.es/es/catalogo/e00125901-spaignmds-normalizado

WCS: https://wcs-mds.idee.es/mds?request=GetCapabilities&service=WCS&version=2.0.1

The 4,096 × 3,896 PNOA image is resampled for the application. Source capture dates and native pixel resolution of each photograph have not been established.

Landmark coordinates, OSM object IDs, source URLs and interpretive placement notes are provided in landmarks.json. No third-party architectural photographs are redistributed as textures.
